name: wermymoolah-js
description: A calendar-first spendings tracker on the PERN stack, in plain JavaScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production npm start -w server
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm start -w desktop
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build
